name: George Gvishiani
bio: Senior Applied Machine Learning Engineer with 10+ years building production AI systems across computer vision, NLP, recommendation systems, and multi-agent LLM architectures. Currently co-founding an AI startup (Microsoft for Startups accelerator) focused on agentic LLM orchestration using LangGraph, LangChain, and CrewAI. Previously built and led AI ventures delivering real-world systems in medical diagnosis, legal tech, fintech, and edtech — from CNN-based object detection pipelines (Faster R-CNN, YOLO, Mask R-CNN) to sequence models with attention mechanisms and reinforcement learning. Background in investment banking (Wharton MBA) and law provides the ability to work across technical and business teams, navigate regulated environments, and translate complex ML capabilities into practical products. Founder of the Wharton Alumni AI Studio, developing domain-specific prompts and collaborating with student startups on applied AI projects.

name: Ines de Bagration de Ulloa
role_title: Co-Founder & Head of Marketing and Social Media
bio: Senior international leader with extensive experience in business transformation and innovation, sales, marketing, and communications. Her work spans strategy and business design, intrapreneurship and entrepreneurship, go-to-market and new business, partnerships, product and category management, CRM, analytics and research, and digital transformation — drawing on design thinking, Lean, visual thinking, and business-model design. She has worked with organisations from startups to CAC 40 companies, across government and public sector, higher education and EdTech, luxury and creative, smart mobility and travel, consulting, fintech, insurance and financial services, real estate, energy, technology, and FMCG. At the Wharton Alumni AI Studio she is Co-Founder and Head of Marketing and Social Media.

name: Didem Ün Ateş
bio: Didem is an AI and Responsible AI executive, algorithm auditor, and certified executive coach with more than 25 years of experience leading technology-driven transformation across industries. As Founder and CEO of Lotus AI, she advises private equity, financial services, and consulting firms — including Goldman Sachs Asset Management and its portfolio companies — on how to scale AI with integrity and foresight, and she serves on Goldman Sachs Asset Management's AI/GenAI Council. She also sits on the boards of the Edge AI Foundation and the Wharton Alumni AI Studio. Earlier in her career she held leadership roles at Microsoft, Accenture, Capgemini, EY, Motorola, and Schneider Electric, including helping launch Business AI solutions at Microsoft Research and leading AI initiatives within its Chief Data Office.

name: Caroline Dahllöf
bio: Caroline is a technical product leader who builds new products in ambiguous, roadmap-free environments — writing code and talking to users in equal measure, with a CS/MS from Brown and an MBA from Wharton. She was the first Data/AI product manager in Meraki's $4B business, where she built its data foundation and shipped a conversational LLM product, and earlier led Kespry's $11M pivot from hardware to an AI platform. At Rhythm & Hues she turned computational-fluid-dynamics research into production visual-effects tools whose technology earned an Academy Technical Achievement Award. She is now co-founding Raven, an AI reading coach for dyslexic children, as its sole engineer.

name: Tomás Gazmuri
bio: Tomás is the Founder and CEO of AndesML, where he builds AI-powered retail-media platforms that help retailers and digital marketplaces turn their traffic into high-margin advertising revenue. He was previously Group Chief Digital Officer at Falabella, one of Latin America's largest retailers, where he led more than 5,000 specialists across four countries and drove EBITDA and profit growth through AI-driven personalization and data monetization. He has also advised and served on the boards of retail, logistics, and fintech companies, scaling operations and launching digital ventures across markets.

name: Jeffrey Gross
role_title: Data Scientist & MLOps Engineer, Booz Allen Hamilton
bio: Jeffrey specializes in operationalizing machine learning — including large language models — using DataOps, MLOps, and DevSecOps across cloud and edge environments. For the past six years he has worked at Booz Allen Hamilton as a data scientist and cloud, DataOps, MLOps, and LLMOps engineer, most recently bringing machine learning and MLOps to a data-engineering team building on Azure. His Penn and Wharton background adds domain depth in life sciences and finance, helping ensure sound data and model development. He works primarily in Python across Azure, AWS, and GCP, with hands-on experience in LLM fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and red-teaming.

name: Mir Haque
bio: Mir Haque, based in San Francisco, is the Founder of Fairbanc. He has previously held roles at Aphaea Capital, Realtor.com, Clear Immigration, and Adobe, with a background spanning strategy, mergers and acquisitions, investment banking, corporate finance, and corporate development. He holds an MBA in Finance from the Wharton School.

name: Rohit Kumar
bio: Rohit is the Founder and CEO of Chapter Apps, an enterprise AI agentic and learning platform used by more than 60 large corporates across emerging markets to engage and connect their global workforces. Drawing on a decade of training employees and integrating enterprise systems, his team builds AI agents designed to learn, adapt, and evolve with a business rather than act as generic tools. He was previously Managing Director of Elsevier's Health Solutions business for South Asia — where he pioneered mobile-first learning — and held senior roles at Microsoft, Wipro, and Oracle, after beginning his career in consulting with BCG and Accenture. Rohit is President of the Wharton Club of Delhi and holds an MBA from Wharton and an engineering degree from IIT Roorkee.

name: Bruno Occhipinti
bio: Bruno is a business leader and strategist with more than 20 years of international experience across Asia and Europe, much of it in the technology and healthcare industries. He is CEO of Qritive, a Singapore-based company building AI-powered solutions for affordable histopathological diagnosis of cancer. He previously founded CrestaLab, a boutique consulting firm, and was General Manager of AICS, a venture of ASUS applying computer vision and NLP to healthcare; earlier roles spanned Philips — chronic-care management, telehealth, and affordable care across Southeast Asia — as well as Samsung Group and business-intelligence software at Hyperion (now Oracle). He holds an MBA from the Wharton School and graduate degrees in international studies, finance, and entrepreneurship, and is an ICF-accredited coach.

name: Keith Robinson
bio: Keith has spent 25+ years investing in, operating, and advising high-growth software businesses across the US and Europe. In 2023 he founded Foundation Partners to originate and execute software and technology investments alongside leading private funds across buyout, growth, private credit, and venture. He was previously Chairman of EMEA Technology Banking & Principal Investments at Barclays, Chief Strategy Officer at Sage, and co-founder of Lamond Capital Partners, a technology-focused hedge fund; earlier he advised on billions of dollars of cross-border software M&A at Arma Partners. He is also an active angel investor and a board member or advisor to numerous high-growth software companies.

name: Beny Rubinstein
bio: Beny is a growth leader and former Microsoft global sales, marketing, and business development executive who now helps organizations and leaders navigate the future with AI. A hands-on intrapreneur and entrepreneur, he brings strategy-consulting and corporate venture capital experience and a focus on startups disrupting their industries. Across 25+ years he has started, incubated, and scaled new businesses — spanning product, marketing, sales, technology, and fundraising — for customers and partners worldwide. He is also a keynote speaker, judge, and mentor in entrepreneurship programs across Israel, Latin America, and the U.S., and speaks English, Hebrew, Spanish, and Portuguese.
